title: Yes schools have often been a place to reinforce the gender binary and allow toxic masculinity to flourish, bringing in stories provides us the first
summary: Yes schools have often been a place to reinforce the gender binary and allow toxic masculinity to flourish, bringing in stories provides us the first step, but questioning our long-held bias, and not knowing is a societal bias is even better.
